API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIURL CategoriesGet URL Quota
Get URL Quota
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/urlCategories/urlQuota

Gets information on the number of unique URLs that are currently provisioned for your organization as well as how many URLs you can add before reaching that number.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
uniqueUrlsProvisioned
int32
remainingUrlsQuota
int32
